erasure.heading: Ubumfihlo & ukususwa kwi-akhawunti
erasure.description: Ungacela ukuthi ulwazi lwakho lomuntu siqu lususwe. Iphrofayela yakho izosuswa isibonakaliso, ukungena kwakho kuzovinjwa, nemininingwane yakho yomuntu siqu izosuswa — amarekhodi wokuthengiselana, ezezimali nawomthetho agcinwa kuphela lapho kudingeka, ngqo njengoba kuchazwe ku-Inqubomgomo Yethu Yobumfihlo nekhasi le-POPIA.
erasure.warningBody: Uma isisuswa, i-akhawunti yakho ayisoze isabuyiselwa ibe sebenzayo. Igama lakho, isithombe sakho nemininingwane yokuxhumana izosuswa, uzophuma kuwonke amawebhu.
erasure.blockedOutro: Sicela uxazulule lezi kuqala, bese uzame futhi.
erasure.successBody: Ukhishwe kuwonke amawebhu. Siyabonga ngokusebenzisa i-Unity.
erasure.successBodyCleanupPending: I-akhawunti yakho isisusiwe futhi ivinjelwe ukusetshenziswa kwemakethe. Ukhishwe. Sisaqeda izinyathelo ezimbalwa zokuhlanza ngemuva — lokhu akudingi lutho kuwena.
erasure.errorGeneric: Kukhona okungahambile kahle. Sicela uzame futhi.
